title: Everything You Need to Know About DIRECTV’s MySports Genre Pack
summary: DIRECTV has a wide range of packages, but here's why the MySports Genre Pack is a favorite for sports lovers.
contentText:

During the streaming era of TV, everything we watch, including live sports, is divided across a number of networks and services. If you’re a sports fan, you might be overwhelmed with all of the streaming options to watch your favorite leagues. However, DIRECTV is the one streaming platform that is a step above the rest, especially when it comes to delivering live sports to your 4K TV, smartphone, tablet, laptop or other internet-connected devices.

DIRECTV’s MySports Genre Pack features nearly 30 live sports channels. It includes top networks, like ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, FOX Sports (FS1), FOX Sports 2 (FS2), NBA TV, CBS Sports Network, MLB Network, NFL Network, NHL Network, TNT, TBS, Tennis Channel, as well as local channels, such as ABC, CBS, NBC and FOX.

Get: DirecTV MySports Genre Pack

Additionally, a subscription to MySports Genre Pack gets you access to ESPN Unlimited to unlock even more ESPN networks, such as ESPN Deportes, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPN on ABC, ESPN+, SEC Network+ and ACC Network Extra. ESPN Unlimited has live sports to even more pro sports leagues, like WNBA, -La Liga, Bundesliga, NWSL, UEFA, NCAA Football, College Football Playoff and much more˄.

Right now, you can get DIRECTV’s MySports Pack for just $49.99 per month for the first two months of service* — a 23% savings per month, or $15 off per month. After the two months are finished, the monthly price auto-renews monthly at its then-current price (curr. $64.99/mo.), unless canceled.

In addition, the genre pack has an unlimited cloud DVR** to record games and matches from pro leagues, including NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL and others. So now, you can relive your favorite sports moments over and over again without the fear of losing DVR cloud storage and your team’s gaming-winning play goes missing in the shuffle.
